ci-bot: [CI] main pipeline failed after merge — job `gpu-smoke-tests` failed in step `smoke-inference`. runner=g4dn, build=sha=abc123. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/12345
sara: heads-up — main turned red right after the merge. who owns the last PR?
mike: that was me (merged #4021). Ill take a look :eyes:
mike: quick skim of the logs shows failure in `kv-cache-integration.test` with kernel alloc errors, looks like OOM-ish stack trace
jon: could be the kernel selector tweak from #4009 interacting with larger batch sizes. first step: rerun the smoke job to see if its flaky
sara: @mike can you trigger a rerun and bisect if it repros?
mike: running rerun now: `./scripts/ci/retry_job.sh gpu-smoke-tests 12345`
devops-bot: Rerun triggered by mike for job gpu-smoke-tests (rerun_id=6789)
mike: rerun finished — green on rerun. looks flaky so far :shrug:
priya: if the rerun is green, still prefer a bisect across the merge window to be confident. flaky flakiness hides regressions
jon: agree. also try pinning the kernel config to the previous selector on a branch to reproduce locally if possible
mike: starting bisect across merges (range: sha=abc100..abc123). will post updates, estimate ~30m
sara: plan: mike bisects + opens revert PR if bisect points at #4021; i'll alert oncall if this doesn't stabilize in the next hour
mike: update: bisect narrowed it down to the change that adjusted kernel selection in #4021 — reproduces consistently when selector X is used
mike: opening a draft revert for quick unblock: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4050 (WIP)
devops-bot: Created bisect run (run_id=6790) — will post results when complete
priya: thanks — if the revert makes main green we can roll forward with a targeted fix to the selector logic; otherwise escalate to eng-runtime
sara: thanks everyone. @mike please post results of the revert run. ping me if the rerun goes red again. keeping thread open but marking this as actionable :white_check_mark:
